description: This file defines the 'CustomerOptionDao' interface which manages data access operations for CustomerOption entities, including listing by store, saving/updating, and retrieving by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionDao
classes.description: An interface extending generic DAO to manage CustomerOption entities, providing methods to list options by store and language, save or update options, and retrieve options by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of CustomerOptions associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a CustomerOption entity, either by saving a new one or updating an existing one, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a unique CustomerOption based on the store and option code.
